title: SAM 2: Segment Anything in Images and Videos

layout.note: Three panels side by side, each captioned below with a bold category word: (a) a vertical stack of input film strip, model box and output film strip; (b) one grey rounded frame holding five pastel modules in a cross layout; (c) a model, annotate, data, train cycle above a mint SA-V dataset card. Dotted leaders run across the panel gaps.

lesson: Present a paper's three deliverables as a task, model, data triptych whose captions start with a bold category word, and tie the model box in each panel together with dotted leaders so the black box in the task panel opens into the architecture in the next.
